content.text: 8. IF NECESSARY, REPLACE FRONT BEARING RETAINER OIL SEAL

content.description: Hand using a screwdriver to pry out oil seal from bearing retainer

items: (a) Using a screwdriver, pry out the oil seal.

content.description: Using SST tool to press in new oil seal into bearing retainer

items: (b) Using SST, press in a new oil seal.

content.text: Oil seal depth: 11.4 — 12.0 mm from retainer end (0.449 — 0.472 in.)
9. IF NECESSARY, REPLACE COUNTER GEAR FRONT BEARING AND SIDE RACE

items: (a) Using snap ring pliers, remove the snap ring.
(b) Using a press and SST, press out the bearing.

content.description: Using snap ring pliers and SST to remove bearing from counter gear

items: (c) Check the side race for wear or damage.
(d) If necessary, remove the side race.

content.text: Using a SST and socket wrench, remove the side race.

content.description: Using SST and socket wrench to remove side race from housing

items: (e) Using a socket wrench, press in a new bearing, side race and inner race.

content.description: Diagram showing pressing in new bearing, side race and inner race using socket wrench with downward arrow indicating press direction
